services.name: Charter Boat
services.desc: 6hr trip is a trolling trip for inshore species such as King mackerel, spanish mackerel, jack, crevelle and ling. Great trip to test the waters before jumping into a longer day. 6hr trip for federal water red snapper(in season) along with some trolling while still doing a shorter day. 6 hour trips can also be scheduled in afternoon. Probably our most popular trip in July-Nov. This trip allows us to fish around deep water shrimpboats for the fish that follow them. often we find blackfin tuna, dorado and ling. blurb: Guests fish in the South Padre Island area from Laguna Madre south to Port Isabel into the Gulf of Mexico targeting big game species like blue marlin, tuna, wahoo, dolphin, sailfish, and more. The 38' sportfishing vessel Reel Madness features full air conditioning and is equipped with the latest electronic fishing and safety gear. Trips include offshore and inshore fishing, trolling, bottom fishing, wreck fishing, and light tackle.
extraNote: Weather monitored; trips rescheduled if weather is bad · Deposit refunded unless no show
